description: Short lease with fencing tokens: claim a task for N seconds, renew, release — Lets many agents agree which one works on a task: acquire a named resource for 1-3600 s, renew it while working, release it when done. Every new acquisition returns a strictly larger fencing token; pass it to the downstream store and reject writes carrying a smaller one, so a paused holder whose lease expired cannot clobber its successor. Re-acquiring as the current holder extends the lease with t

holder.description: Your worker id. Required for acquire, renew and release.

requestId.description: Caller-chosen id for this mutation. A retry with the same id and same input returns the stored response (24 h) instead of applying twice; the same id with different input is rejected. Send one on every mutation you may retry: without it a retry is applied again (fleet-memory record appends a duplicate; a repeated spend-ledger commit or release answers NO_HOLD because the first call already took effect).

resource.description: Task or resource name, e.g. invoice:INV-1009 or deploy:prod.

tenantId.description: Required for API-key callers (namespaced as key:<tenantId>; keep it unguessable). Ignored when a wallet paid: the payer address is the tenant.

token.description: Fencing token from acquire; required for renew and release.

name: lease
